description: Single storey wrap-around side to rear extension, two-storey side extensions, alterations to roof; two rear dormers, one front dormer, front porch; external alterations; detached single storey garage to front (demolition of front to side extension; front porch, conservatory, chimney stack and carport) (Amended Plans)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height: 115%;">A010
REV P01, A013 REV P01, A101 REV P01, A102 REV P01, A200 REV P01, A201 REV P01, A300
REV P01, A301 REV P01, A011 REV P01, A012 REV P01, A001 REV P01, A003 REV P02, A020
REV P03, AOO4 REV P03, Reasonable Exemption Statements, Arboricultural Impact
Assessment REV A, PHOTOS, Tree Report, Bat Survey, Design and Access Statement&nbsp;</span>

Notwithstanding the submitted details and approved plans, the development hereby permitted shall not shall not progress beyond damp proof course level , until details of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces noted below have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority: - the extensions including windows, doors, balustrade and roofing materials; - the ground surfacing; including all hard standing. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p class="MsoNormal">The development hereby approved shall be carried out fully
in accordance with the submitted Arboricultural Report and Tree Protection
Measures included within it. All approved tree protection fencing, ground
protection, and safeguarding measures shall be installed prior to the
commencement of any works on site and shall be retained in situ for the
duration of the construction works. No excavation, level changes, storage of
materials, or construction activity shall take place within the identified Root
Protection Areas except as specifically outlined in the approved Arboricultural
Report.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><br></p>
